message.label_caveat: These are research reference figures, not the label. Pre-harvest and re-entry intervals vary by state, formulation and crop, and labels change between seasons. The label in the applicator's hand governs, and it is the legal document.
message.message: American Robin has a proposed threshold that nobody has approved yet, so nothing was compared.

options.title: Netting over high-value blocks from straw colour
Scare devices — propane cannons, distress calls, reflective tape — rotated so birds do not habituate
Prompt, clean harvest; remove dropped and cull fruit
Kestrel and owl nest boxes, raptor perches

organism.name: American Robin
organism.protected_note: Protected by the Migratory Bird Treaty Act: lethal control needs a USFWS depredation permit. Lead with netting, scare devices and habitat.

message.protected_species_note: American Robin is protected (MBTA). Protected by the Migratory Bird Treaty Act: lethal control needs a USFWS depredation permit. Lead with netting, scare devices and habitat. Non-lethal options only.

threshold.name: PAT-00010
threshold.recommended_methods: MBTA-protected: netting, rotated scare devices, raptor perches and kestrel boxes, prompt harvest. Lethal control only under a USFWS depredation permit.
